At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

Every great ad starts with a brief, and in most teams the brief is still where things go wrong: scattered documents, missing context, endless back-and-forth. As a Product Designer for Brief mode, you'll own how briefs are created, understood and brought to life inside Pencil. You'll design the experience from the first upload through AI analysis, collaborative editing, review and approval, all the way to the moment a brief turn into the finished creative. You'll work where agentic AI meets real creative workflows, shaping how people and agents work together: when the AI suggests, when it acts, and how users stay in control. Your work will help a global brand team and a two-person agency brief with the same clarity and confidence.

Key responsibilities:

•
Own the end-to-end Brief mode experience

•
Design agentic and AI-assisted interactions and journeys prototyping fast (Figma/ AI tools) and writing clear, build-ready handovers

•
Work closely with Product, Engineering and AI teams from discovery to delivery, Run user research and usability testing, and use product analytics and session replays to find friction and back design decisions with evidence

•
Help evolve and maintain Pencil's design system with reusable patterns that hold up for enterprise brands and self-serve users alike

Your background:

•
5+ years of product design experience on B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools, with a portfolio showing end-to-end ownership of shipped features

•
Hands-on experience designing AI-powered products: generative, conversational or agentic interfaces, including uncertainty, loading and error states

•
Strong interaction and systems thinking: multi-step flows, permissions, statuses and edge cases, all brought together in a coherent experience

•
Fluency in Figma and rapid prototyping; comfort with AI prototyping tools or front-end basics (React, component libraries) is a strong plus

•
Experience using qualitative research and quantitative data (e.g. Amplitude) to shape and validate decisions

•
Bonus: experience in adtech, marketing, creative operations or agency workflows

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

•
Are curious about where AI is going and excited, not threatened, by designing for the creative people it's meant to empower

•
Move fast and iterate: you'd rather put a prototype in front of users this week than polish a deck for a month

•
Take ownership: you spot problems beyond your brief, speak up and see them through

•
Communicate directly and collaborate openly, and give and take candid feedback with engineers, PMs and customers

•
Care about craft and outcomes equally, and hold the details to a high standard without losing sight of the impact

•
Frame unclear problems and question assumptions. Solve the real problem, not just the symptoms.

KPIs & Success Measures

•
Have 5 clients actively use the entire briefing flow by the end of 2026

•
Adoption of briefs: % increase of briefs submitted per active workspace.

•
Adoption of approvals: % of deliverables that reach a final approval decision.

•
Adoption of agents: % of briefs where a Brief Mode agent is initiated.

Benefits:

25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

•
Health insurance / private medical cover

•
Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

•
Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

•
Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

•
Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

•
Flexible working hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior UI/UX Designer – Portals to help define the next generation of intelligent experiences across Intermedia's products.

In this role, you will design experiences that make artificial intelligence useful, intuitive, trustworthy, and approachable for business users. You will work at the intersection of UX strategy, interaction design, generative AI, conversational experiences, and enterprise software , turning sophisticated AI capabilities into simple experiences that solve real customer problems.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML teams, Engineering, Research, and other designers throughout the complete product lifecycle—from customer and market research through concepts, prototyping, development, launch, and post-launch analysis.

This is not simply a role for adding AI features to existing interfaces. You will help define how users interact with AI across our products , including copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, recommendations, summarization, intelligent automation, and agentic experiences.

Key Responsibilities
AI Experience Design

• Design intuitive user experiences for AI-powered capabilities across web, desktop, mobile, and administrative interfaces.

• Explore new interaction models for generative AI, including conversational interfaces, copilots, AI assistants, intelligent recommendations, content generation, summarization, and AI-driven workflow automation.

• Design experiences for emerging agentic AI capabilities where AI systems can reason, recommend actions, execute tasks, and coordinate multi-step workflows on behalf of users.

• Translate complex AI functionality into simple, understandable interactions appropriate for everyday business users.

• Determine when AI should proactively assist users versus when users should explicitly initiate or control AI functionality.

• Design effective patterns for prompts, suggestions, generated content, AI actions, confirmations, feedback, and human intervention.

• Create experiences that communicate what an AI system is doing, why it made a recommendation, and what actions it has taken or intends to take.

UX & Product Design

• Own design initiatives from discovery and concept development through prototyping, implementation, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Conduct user research, usability studies, interviews, competitive analysis, and workflow analysis to understand customer needs and behaviors.

• Translate customer problems and product requirements into user journeys, workflows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.

• Develop and validate design hypotheses through rapid prototyping and user testing.

• Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through thoughtful UX and intelligent automation.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to evaluate experiences and recommend improvements.

• Work closely with Product Management to ensure designs address meaningful customer problems and measurable business outcomes.

AI Trust & Responsible Design

• Design AI experiences that establish appropriate levels of trust, transparency, and user control .

• Clearly distinguish AI-generated information and actions where appropriate.

• Design graceful experiences for uncertainty, incomplete information, errors, hallucinations, and situations where the AI cannot confidently complete a request.

• Create effective confirmation, undo, escalation, and human-in-the-loop patterns for AI-driven actions.

• Design feedback mechanisms that allow users to evaluate, correct, or improve AI-generated results.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Privacy, and Legal teams to incorporate responsible AI principles into the user experience.

• Help establish UX guidelines for consistent and responsible use of AI throughout Intermedia products.

Design Systems

• Contribute to and evolve Intermedia's design system to support AI-powered experiences.

• Define reusable patterns and components for conversational interfaces, AI recommendations, generated content, AI actions, status indicators, feedback mechanisms, and agentic workflows.

• Ensure new AI capabilities integrate naturally with established product experiences rather than feeling like disconnected features.

• Maintain consistency across products while identifying where emerging AI interactions require new design paradigms.

• Partner with designers and developers to ensure design-system components are practical, scalable, accessible, and consistently implemented.

Collaboration & Leadership

• Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, AI/ML engineers, software engineers, architects, researchers, and other designers.

• Facilitate design workshops and collaborative discovery sessions to explore customer problems and AI opportunities.

• Clearly communicate design rationale, research findings, user needs, and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Challenge assumptions and advocate for customer-centered solutions when technology or implementation considerations begin driving the experience.

• Provide design leadership and mentorship to other designers and help raise the overall quality of UX across the organization.

• Collaborate effectively across multiple teams and product areas to create coherent end-to-end customer experiences.

• Stay current with emerging AI technologies, interaction patterns, and design practices and translate relevant developments into practical product experiences.

Our Expectations

• 5+ years of professional UI/UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience, ideally designing complex SaaS or enterprise software.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, complex workflows, interaction design, and thoughtful problem solving.

• Excellent knowledge of usability, UX/UI, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and human factors principles.

• Strong ability to analyze complex requirements and turn them into simple, elegant solutions.

• Experience conducting or participating in user research and usability testing.

• Strong proficiency with Figma , prototyping tools, and modern design-system practices.

• Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering in an Agile software-development environment.

• Strong communication, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work effectively with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the broader product and customer experience.

AI Experience & Knowledge

We don't expect you to be an AI engineer, but we do expect curiosity and practical fluency with modern AI technologies.

The ideal candidate has:

• Experience designing products or features powered by generative AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation.

• Understanding of large language models (LLMs) and the opportunities and limitations they introduce into product experiences.

• Familiarity with conversational UX and natural-language interfaces.

• Understanding of concepts such as prompts, context, AI-generated content, confidence and uncertainty, hallucinations, and AI feedback loops.

• Familiarity with AI agents and emerging patterns for designing systems that can perform multi-step actions on behalf of users.

• Experience thinking through trust, transparency, explainability, privacy, and user control in AI experiences.

• A strong interest in experimenting with new AI tools and interaction models.

Advantages

• Experience designing enterprise communications, collaboration, contact center, productivity, or workflow-automation products.

• Experience designing AI copilots, assistants, conversational interfaces, or agentic workflows.

• Experience developing or contributing to large-scale design systems.

• Experience with voice and multimodal interfaces.

• Understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design.

• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and the technical constraints of modern web applications.

• Experience using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools.

• Experience working with globally distributed Product and Engineering teams.

What Success Looks Like

As a Senior UI/UX Designer – AI, you will help ensure that AI at Intermedia is not simply powerful technology—it is a valuable and trusted customer experience .

Success means:

• Customers immediately understand how AI can help them.

• Complex AI capabilities feel simple and natural to use.

• Users remain informed and in control when AI recommends or takes actions.

• AI features integrate seamlessly into existing customer workflows.

• Common AI interaction patterns become consistent across Intermedia products.

• Research and customer feedback meaningfully influence AI product decisions.

• Product and Engineering teams view Design as a strategic partner in determining what AI experiences should be built , not simply how they should look.

Ultimately, you will help establish the design language and interaction principles that shape how customers experience AI across Intermedia's portfolio.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together!

How will you make an impact

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems to help shape the next generation of Aurora, the design system that underpins Iterable’s product experience.

This role is for a systems-minded designer who is equally comfortable in Figma, documentation, code-adjacent workflows, and technical conversations with engineers. You’ll help Aurora become more than a collection of components: a versioned, structured, verifiable system of design intent that people and AI tools can reliably understand and use.

You’ll contribute to the evolution of Aurora’s visual language, component architecture, tokens, patterns, and guidance. You’ll also help define the specifications, schemas, tooling, and contribution practices that make those decisions durable across Figma, code, documentation, prototypes, and AI-assisted product development.

Your goal is make it easier for teams, and the tools that help them build, to produce consistent, accessible, high-quality product experiences without guessing.

What you’ll do

• Lead Aurora’s evolution across foundations, components, patterns, and product-specific assemblies.

• Define component contracts and structured specs covering anatomy, properties, variants, states, slots, composition, accessibility, and intended use.

• Make design intent machine-readable for Figma, code, documentation, prototypes, and AI coding agents, including behaviors Figma cannot express alone.

• Partner with engineers to connect Figma, tokens, React, Storybook, prototypes, and documentation through deterministic workflows that minimize drift.

• Strengthen Aurora’s token architecture, themes, aliases, states, and core foundations.

• Establish audits and quality gates for hardcoded values, invalid combinations, missing states, accessibility gaps, and system divergence.

• Help version and communicate system changes through change logs, release notes, impact reports, and architectural decision records.

• Explore responsible AI/LLM use of Aurora, then build prototypes, tools, and guidance that help teams apply the system consistently.

• Audit product surfaces, improve high-impact inconsistencies, and mentor designers and engineers in systems thinking and AI-ready workflows.

What you’ll bring

• 6+ years of product design experience, including building or evolving design systems at scale.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong craft, interaction quality, accessibility, and systems thinking.

• Deep Figma expertise: variables and modes, properties, variants, slots, branching, libraries, and scalable organization.

• Experience defining component APIs, anatomy, states, behaviors, composition rules, and usage guidance.

• Comfort with schemas, contracts, taxonomies, dependencies, validation, versioning, and change management.

• Strong engineering partnership across implementation, testing, accessibility, APIs, and release quality.

• Familiarity with Storybook, Figma Code Connect, token pipelines, and documentation or design-system management tools.

• Ability to write precise documentation for humans and machines, with a practical understanding of how AI coding agents consume context and where they drift.

• Strong accessibility knowledge, asynchronous communication, organizational skills, and a pragmatic, hands-on multiplier mindset.

Bonus points

• Experience with B2B SaaS and complex, data-rich workflows.

• Ability to use HTML, CSS, and React for prototyping, communication, or quality refinements.

• Experience with design tokens, transformation, linting, CI checks, design-to-code pipeline.

• Experience with APIs, GitHub workflows, command-line tools, or automation for design-system operations.

• Experience with AI/LLM instructions, agent skills, retrieval-friendly documentation, generated-UI evaluation, advanced prototyping, or cross-platform systems.

How you’ll know you’re succeeding

• Teams can find and apply the right Aurora component, pattern, token, and requirement without relying on tribal knowledge.

• Specs and component contracts stay close to code and clearly describe structure, configuration, states, behavior, accessibility, and composition.

• AI-assisted workflows use current Aurora guidance and tokens instead of fabricating values or creating avoidable divergence.

• Audits, release practices, and shared tooling catch issues early while helping product teams move faster with more consistent, accessible, polished experiences.

Working relationships

You’ll work closely with:

• Product designers across Iterable, helping them apply Aurora and contribute back to the system.

Overview

At Netlify , we’re building a platform to empower web developers to build better, more elaborate web projects than ever before. We’re aiming to change the landscape of modern web development. Netlify currently serves more than 700,000 developers worldwide.

We’re a venture-backed company, and so far we’ve raised about $45 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, Bloomberg, and prominent founders and professionals in our space.

Netlify is a diverse group of incredible talent from all over the world. We’re ~40% woman or non-binary, and are composed of about half as many nationalities as we are team members.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a user experience and design manager to lead, nurture, and grow our incredible product design team. The ideal candidate is someone that has led and grown design teams, has a track record of successful mentorship, and has a design vision and skillset aligned to accelerate Netlify’s ambition of a world-class developer experience for web developers. The candidate should have demonstrable success launching and iterating world-class design experiences with their team.

This person should be a strong partner with product and engineering and should push us to constantly and consistently deliver a great user experience. The candidate should have experience in implementing and leading design processes and systems. They should be well versed and opinionated in modern design best practices, utilizing quantitative and qualitative data as part of the design process, and bring fresh ideas and methods for product design and discovery.

The ideal candidate should be passionate about injecting design thinking into our product process and has demonstrable ability doing so. They’ve lead initiatives like design sprints and have onboarded engineering and product teams into design-thinking processes, making it integral to the product development process. They fight for the end-user while balancing the overall product and business needs of the org. The candidate should show wins of their design teams being integral to the success of their products and companies, contributing new ideas and big product wins, and creating a system around doing so.

About the role:

This management role will oversee the product design team which includes Product and UX Designers. In this role, you will have individual contributors reporting to you. You will need to help hire and grow the team.

You should love helping your team grow and develop, taking care of their professional growth needs as well as quality of day-to-day work life, being an advocate for their work and developing a strong sense of direction.

You’ll be a confident leader with the ability to facilitate conversations and decision-making within the team. You’ll be responsible for setting, tracking and communicating metrics around work output and goals.

In addition to people management responsibilities, you will need to establish a hiring process for the Product design and research. You will focus on building a happy, healthy and diverse team.

You will work help develop metrics for your function that represent their work and contributions.

You will also work closely with other managers and leaders within the organization to plan projects, schedule resourcing for those projects and identify risks.

We have a small headquarters in San Francisco but we are a largely distributed engineering team, so remote applicants are welcome. You will need to enable the team to work productively across different timezones. Fostering good habits of documentation, empathy, and integrity to deliver on committed work are some of the key elements for success on our team. Experience working and managing remote teams is a big plus.

Ideal Candidate

• Experience leading teams of Product & UX Designers through the complete product discovery to delivery life cycle.

• A champion for product usability and someone who removes roadblocks so teams can continue to work closely together as we scale the organization.

• Familiar with the tool sets the teams use (Figma, GitHub, Abstract, Storybook, etc.)

• Ability to hire thoughtfully and quickly.

• Ability to develop the individual’s skills and professional careers of Product Designers and researchers.

• Can supervise work priorities and direction by collaborating with the PM and development teams.

• Ability to work across multiple timezones with remote colleagues

• A desire to succeed personally through the success of the team

About Netlify

Of everything we’ve ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team.

We believe that empowered, engaged colleagues do their best work. We’ll be giving you the tools you need to succeed and looking to you for suggestions to improve not just in your daily job, but every aspect of building a company. Whether you work from our main office in San Francisco or you are a remote employee, we’ll be working together a lot—paring, collaborating, debating, and learning. We want you to succeed! About 60% of the company are remote across the globe, the rest are in our HQ in San Francisco.

To learn a bit more about our team and who we are, make sure to visit our about page .

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

With your application, please include: A thoughtful cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role and why you’d like to work at Netlify. A resume or short listing of job history. (A link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine.)

When we receive your complete application with the items above, we’ll get back to you about the next steps.

We are looking for an experienced UI Designer with a strong mind for user experience who wants to design the future of Kibana.

Philosophy

Designing for highly technical products is uniquely challenging. It requires thoroughly-honed skills in interaction design and a keen sense of how people should use our UIs grounded by an inherent sense of empathy for users. We also care deeply about giving you full ownership of what you’re working on. Our company fundamentally believes great minds achieve greatness when they are set free and are supported and challenged by their peers, which is clearly visible in our organization. We feel that everyone should be welcome to comment on absolutely anything, regardless of their role within the company.

Responsibilities

• Design user interfaces with the best tool for the task, whether it’s Sketch, InvisionApp, CSS, HTML, or directly in the browser

• Maintain and evolve the design of our UI component framework

• Design new visualizations to help present/make sense of complicated data aggregations

• Help determine product requirements in collaboration with people throughout Elastic

• Communicate goals, ideas, and rationales behind design decisions

• Create and integrate UX design standards into a consistent user experience

• Review GitHub PRs and provide design feedback to the team

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio that showcases UI/UX design skills for highly technical applications

About Elastic

Elastic is on a mission to make real-time data exploration easy and available to anyone. As the company behind the popular open source projects Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana, we're looking to hire team members invested in realizing this goal.

Founded in 2012 in Amsterdam by the people behind Elasticsearch and Apache Lucene, Elastic set forth a vision that search can solve a plethora of data problems. The origins of the company start back in 2010 when Shay Banon wrote the first lines of Elasticsearch and open sourced it as a distributed search engine.

With the rise of cloud computing and changes in IT infrastructure demanding requirements such as real-time search across infinite amounts of structured and unstructured data, Shay foresaw the need for a new type of software to solve today’s real-world data problems. Steven Schuurman, Uri Boness, and Simon Willnauer shared in Shay’s vision, joining forces to create the Elastic company we have today.

Since then, the creators of Kibana, Logstash, and Beats have joined the Elastic family, rounding out a product portfolio known as the Elastic Stack, which is used by millions of developers around the world. The Elastic family unites employees across 32 countries into one coherent team, while the broader community spans across over 100 countries.

Tegy is building the strategy team ambitious companies wish they had. It turns messy business context into defensible decisions, models, memos, decks, and action plans with senior-grade rigor on demand.

**What you will own**
1. Core workflows. Map and design the journeys from messy context and questions through analysis, artifacts, decisions, and next actions.

3. Prototyping and validation. Turn uncertain ideas into prototypes, test them with users or strong evidence, and show how the design changed.
4. Product UI and design system. Establish a coherent visual language, components, states, and interaction patterns that can scale with the product.
5. Implementation quality. Work with engineers through build and review so the shipped experience matches the intent and handles real edge cases.

## About MyArchitectAI

MyArchitectAI is an AI rendering platform used by architects, interior designers, and visualization professionals in over 150 countries. We turn CAD designs, sketches, and line drawings into photorealistic renders in seconds, with no installs, no hardware requirements, and no learning curve.

## Why we're hiring

Our product works. Our retention and engagement has a lot of room for improvement. Too many people sign up, render a few images, and never come back, or cancel when their current project ends. That's you.

## What you'll own

**Activation and engagement**
Dig into user behavior in PostHog and Supabase. Figure out where people get stuck between signup and their first "wow" render, and why paying users stop rendering. Turn that into a prioritized list of experiments, run them, and report what moved.

**UX improvements**
Take existing flows and make them simpler and nicer to look at. Our users judge us on how good the app looks, because that's their job. You'll design in Claude Design on top of our existing design system (and improve it), so you do need taste and the ability to tell good from almost good.

**New features from scratch**
From problem to shipped. Talk to users, define the feature, design it, write a spec, QA it on staging, ship it, measure it.

## Who this is for

- You've been a PM, growth PM, or product designer at a SaaS company, ideally one selling to non-technical users. B2B or prosumer both fine.
- You're comfortable doing your own analysis. Funnels, cohorts, SQL, experiment design, knowing when a result is noise.
- You have visual taste and opinions about UI. You can look at a screen and clearly explain why it feels off.
- You write clearly. Most of your output will be specs, hypotheses, and short reports, and other people have to act on them.
- You're self-directed. Nobody will assign you tickets. You'll find the problems yourself.

## Who this is not for

- People who need a designer, an analyst, and an engineer to get anything done.
- People who want to write strategy docs or call all-hands. We need someone who ships fast.

## The deal

- Around 20 hours a week to start. Can grow to full-time if it works for both sides.
- We start with a paid, scoped project so we both see how it goes. If it's good, we move to a monthly retainer.
- You invoice us as a contractor. Location doesn't matter.

## How we work

- Fully remote and mostly async.
- Specs go into Linear. Design happens in Claude Design. Analysis happens in PostHog and SQL.
- We use AI tools heavily and expect you to as well. If you're skeptical of AI-assisted design and coding, this isn't the right place.
- Short feedback loops. You'll get a yes or no within hours, not a week.
- You'll talk to real users. Support is handled by the founders, and you'll have access to every conversation.

## How to apply

Skip the cover letter. Send us:

1. One thing you shipped that moved a metric, and what it moved.
2. Why you're a good fit.
3. Your rate assuming 20hrs/week.

Keep it short. We read everything.

With a strong foundation in investment banking and asset management, the company has honed technological best practices through partnerships with some of the world’s most respected investment firms.
At the core of Lenox Park Solutions’ offerings is ‘RoundTables’, an exclusive, cloud-based data platform, which enables organizations to efficiently and securely gather and centralize relevant metrics and data. This allows decision makers to measure ‘Impact’ to inform and assess investment decisions. Lenox Park Solutions has successfully introduced its technology to the marketplace, attracting a prestigious client base that includes some of the most sophisticated and globally well-respected investment institutions.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are seeking a fractional UX/UI DESIGN PARTNER (an independent designer or a small design firm) to bring dedicated design attention to RoundTables, Lenox Park Solutions’ platform. The engagement reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and works in close, hands-on collaboration with the engineering team, the Product Manager, and the client services team; the colleagues on the front lines with the platform’s day-to-day users and with the clients who rely on RoundTables for reporting and survey administration. This is the company’s first dedicated design role: to date, design has been handled in-house only informally, by team members whose primary responsibilities lay elsewhere, and bringing in focused design expertise is a deliberate next step for a maturing platform.
Lenox Park Solutions has invested substantially in RoundTables including professional design work delivered through a previous external design engagement and the platform already serves a sophisticated client base. This is not a rebuild or a redesign from scratch; it is an opportunity to take strong, established work and make it better for the people who use it. The focus is on enhancing the experience of current users: bringing greater consistency to the design, refining the most important workflows, and closing the gap between design intent and what reaches production. A core part of the engagement is developing a deep understanding of the user journey which may include research with Lenox Park’s clients and the asset owners, asset managers, and survey administrators who use RoundTables ensuring design decisions are grounded in real use.

**RESPONSIBILITIES & QUALIFICATIONS**

As Lenox Park Solutions’ UX/UI Design Partner you will:

1. Work with the platform as it exists today and make it clearer, more consistent, and easier to use.
2. Develop a deep understanding of the RoundTables user journey including, where useful, research with clients and end users, and apply it to refine the platform’s most important experiences, such as the dashboards and workflows used by survey hosts, survey takers, and administrators, the survey-taking experience, the manager impact report, and contact-list management.
3. Bring consistency to the platform’s existing design language, establishing clear, brand-aligned standards and reusable patterns in Figma so design and engineering stay aligned and new work ships faithfully.
4. Collaborate closely and iteratively with the engineering team, the Product Manager, and the client services team, producing development-ready specifications and handoff documentation so that what reaches production matches what was designed.

The ideal designer or firm brings:

1. Demonstrated experience designing and shipping B2B SaaS or data-platform interfaces, ideally complex, data-dense web applications, supported by a portfolio of end-to-end UX and UI work.
2. A strong UX foundation in user research, role-based information architecture, and user-journey mapping, with the ability to translate how a product is actually used into clear, prioritized design improvements.
3. Proven skill in working within an existing product, refining and enhancing live interfaces and bringing consistency to an established design language, rather than rebuilding from the ground up.
4. Fluency with Figma for design standards, reusable components, and accessible, WCAG-aligned patterns, alongside a rigorous, developer-ready handoff practice that keeps production output faithful to the agreed design.
5. A self-directed, collaborative operating style suited to a fractional, milestone-based independent engagement, and comfort working hands-on alongside an internal engineering, product, and client services team.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

This is a fractional, independent-contractor engagement rather than a salaried employee position, and compensation is milestone-based rather than hourly. Each phase of work, from user-journey research through refined platform workflows, design standards, and developer handoff, is tied to a defined deliverable and a fixed fee agreed in advance, so investment is predictable and linked directly to completed outcomes.
• Independent-contractor (1099) engagement; open to either an individual designer or a design firm.
• Compensation structured as fixed fees tied to agreed project milestones and deliverables, rather than hourly billing.
• Milestones, deliverables, and fees defined and scheduled with the selected designer or firm before work begins, with payment on acceptance of each completed milestone.
• A fractional, project-scoped engagement, with the possibility of an ongoing design retainer once the initial milestones are complete.

**BENEFITS**

As an independent-contractor engagement, this role is not eligible for the employee benefits programs offered to Lenox Park Solutions’ US-based staff which include medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, health and wellness reimbursement, and a 401(k) plan.

**LOCATION**

Remote. Lenox Park Solutions’ staff work remotely, as we believe team members are most productive when they live in the places they choose and establish schedules that offer flexibility. Certain meetings may take place in person and require physical presence in New York City.

**COME WORK WITH US!**

If this opportunity sounds appealing to you, please email a resume and a portfolio — or, for firms, representative case studies — to lps.careers1@lenoxparkinc.com. A brief note describing relevant SaaS or data-platform design work and your approach to design systems is encouraged but optional.

**DEADLINE TO APPLY: **Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

**OPTIMIZING HUMAN CAPITAL**

At Lenox Park, we measure diversity rather than describe it. We built the Lenox Park Impact Score (LPI), in collaboration with our clients, to benchmark human capital optimization across ownership, leadership, and workforce on both gender and racial/ethnic dimensions, and we hold our own firm to the standard we set for everyone else. In an industry not known for representation, the numbers speak plainly: Lenox Park ranks in the 94th percentile of 3,249 asset management firms on the RoundTables platform overall, and in the 95th percentile for racial representation across our workforce. We are equally committed to building an environment where colleagues who identify as LGBTQIA+, as neurodivergent, or as religious minorities feel genuinely welcomed and where gender representation, in the 74th percentile of firms on the platform, keeps improving as we grow. If you want to do excellent work somewhere that measures what it claims to value and holds itself to it, you’ll be in good company here.

**OUR HOPE**

We continue to assemble exceptionally talented and diverse individuals, so our firm has the best chance of maintaining the trajectory of success we have established to date. Individuals who have found the most comprehensive forms of success and fulfillment at Lenox Park Solutions tend to align with our mission. They also exhibit professionalism, natural curiosity about the finance or technology arenas, and an eagerness to learn. We value individuals who have a record of great judgement and a keen interest in developing themselves and the team around them. We are driven by a mission that prioritizes representation and opportunity. We hold ourselves accountable to setting an example, and being the change we want to see in the world.

HARMONICA

We are a London based stealth startup (ex Revolut, Meta, Imperial PhD) building the defining AI company for ageing. Ageing is one of society's biggest problems, and for us it's personal. We're an expat team building for our own ageing parents, who live far away in China, India, Brazil, and Italy.

We build voice first technology to keep seniors at home, healthier and happier for longer.

Our first product is Olympia, a proactive voice assistants for older adults living at home. She provides conversation and stimulation, remembers what matters, connects the family, and notices changes in wellbeing. Real seniors already use her in real homes. She's voice-first, proactive, and gets more useful the longer she knows someone.

Hear what it means to live with Olympia from one of our user: https://canva.link/ay0pj21d8yt6k6y

OUR AMBITION

By 2050, the number of people over 80 will triple, and care systems are already running out of money, workers, and capacity. Today's system sees the cliff: the fall, the hospital admission, the crisis. Olympia sees the drift, and acts while the problem is still small.

We're here to win the category. The opportunity is massive: this is where tech meets good, at the scale of how the world ages. Daily use of Olympia builds a picture of how people age that nobody has had before: cognition, mood, routines, mobility, social connection. Across millions of homes, that intelligence lets families act earlier, helps clinicians support far more people, and saves billions in care spending. Harmonica becomes the infrastructure an ageing world runs on.

Five-year goal: 250,000 homes, $170M revenue. You'd be one of the first designers shaping the product that gets us there.

WHO WE ARE

Team from Meta, Revolut, Tractable, and an Imperial PhD in voice AI. We've built consumer products at scale, taken AI products from pilots to eight-figure contracts, and worked at the frontier of real-time speech.

Backed by Eileen Burbidge's NFG Ventures, Mati Staniszewski of ElevenLabs, and many more, with research collaborators at Oxford, Wharton, and Toronto.

THE DESIGN PROBLEM

Most software assumes the user will learn its interface. We're building an interface that learns the person.

What should an AI companion become when its users did not grow up with software? A human face, an abstract presence, or voice alone? When should it speak first? How does it show it is listening, remembering, acting? These are not polish questions. They decide whether an 84-year-old trusts Olympia enough to speak with her every day.

You'll answer them through rapid experiments with real seniors in real homes. This interaction model barely exists as a discipline. You'll help invent it.

WHAT WE'LL DO TOGETHER

Have the best time of your career working on an awesome, meaningful product with super talented people.

- A voice-first interaction model: turn-taking, interruptions, silence, proactive moments, recovery when Olympia gets it wrong. Less like operating software, more like being understood.
- A generative interface system: the screen assembles the right thing around the conversation (a memory, crossword, reminder, photo) and stays coherent, accessible, trustworthy.
- Embodiment grounded in evidence. Avatar, abstract presence, or voice alone? Prototype, test during onboarding, learn what works.
- A calm, accessible home experience. Legible with low vision, forgiving of shaky hands, warm without being childish or clinical.
- The family connection loop. Messaging that turns everyday moments into reassurance and prompts like "call your mum", while protecting the older adult's agency and privacy.
- An agent that can act: medication, appointments, transport, everyday tasks through conversation.
- A research and experimentation engine. Fast prototypes, field tests, clear measures of trust. We have hypotheses; you replace them with evidence.

A specialist studio handles marketing and visual identity. This role owns the product experience: interaction system, generative UI, embodiment, accessibility.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Obsessed with human-computer interaction and the future of AI interfaces. You have opinions on why today's voice assistants feel awkward, and the curiosity to test them.
- You think in systems, behaviours, and moments, not screens.
- You prototype to learn: Figma, code, motion, AI tools, whatever gets an idea in front of a user fastest.
- You do your own research. Sit with an older adult, notice what they do rather than what they say.
- You know how hard simple is. Accessibility is part of the architecture, not a checklist.
- Shipped consumer products. Your portfolio shows craft and what changed after real people used it.
- High agency. You'd rather test a rough version in a home this week than wait for a perfect brief.
- You care about the mission. Low ego, kind, hard-working. No politics.

BONUS

- Voice UI, conversational design, generative interfaces, motion, front-end prototyping, health or care products, designing for older adults.

WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

- Where you went to university, or whether you did. Show us the work and how you think.
- Where you live. Overlap with London hours matters more than your postcode.
- Gender, age, background, or anything else that isn't the work.

FOUNDING DESIGNER MEANS FOUNDING

You will be integral to whether Harmonica succeeds. That's literal, and it comes with the freedom to match.

- Set the design bar: how we research, prototype, test, and decide something is ready for a home.
- Shape product strategy. Design is not downstream here. You help decide what Olympia becomes and what we refuse to build.
- Build on a working foundation. Olympia is already used by real seniors.
- Create the design system that keeps generative interfaces coherent as the product adapts to each person.
- Hire the team. Shape future design roles.
- Real equity and a real voice in product and company decisions.
- You'll learn more here in one year than in three at a corporate. That's a promise.

THE PACKAGE

- 0.5% to 1% equity, depending on seniority, on a standard four-year vest.
- What that could be worth. If we hit the plan ($170M revenue in year five), a business like ours trades at roughly 5x to 10x revenue, putting Harmonica between $850M and $1.7B. After typical dilution from future rounds, your stake would be worth in the region of $2.5M to $10M+. This is a projection, not a guarantee; startups fail, and we're telling you what we're aiming at.
- Competitive salary.
- Hardware, tooling, research, and model spend. Nobody waits for approval to test a promising idea.
- Maximum creative freedom, and a team building this for our own parents.

• Experience mentoring or providing direction to other UI/UX Designers

• Onboarding and FTUE

Claude / Claude Code

•
OpenAI Codex

•
Lovable

•
Cursor

•
Replit

•
Figma AI

•
AI image/video generation tools

•
Emerging prototyping and agentic development tools

You don't need to be a production engineer.

But you should be capable of building functional prototypes yourself .

If your workflow still looks like:

requirements → wireframes → Figma → developer handoff

you are probably not the right fit.

We are looking for someone whose workflow increasingly looks like:

problem → prototype → test → learn → iterate → ship

Strong product thinking

The strongest candidates think like a designer and a product manager.

You should naturally ask:

•
What user problem are we solving?

•
Is this actually valuable?

•
What is the simplest version we can test?

•
What behavior are we trying to change?

•
How will we know if this worked?

•
Can we prototype this before engineering builds it?

•
What happens after the first session?

•
Why would someone come back tomorrow?

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and proposing better product solutions rather than simply executing a brief.

Big Plus: Motion & Interaction Design

Motion design experience is a major advantage.

We want our products to feel alive, especially as AI makes software increasingly conversational, personalized, and dynamic.

Experience with any of the following is valuable:

•
Rive

•
After Effects

•
Principle

•
ProtoPie

•
Framer

•
Lottie

•
Advanced Figma prototyping

•
Native mobile animation patterns

•
Microinteractions and gesture design

You don't need to be a dedicated motion designer, but having strong instincts around movement, interaction, and delight will make you stand out.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

•
You obsess over consumer products and constantly notice why certain experiences feel dramatically better than others

•
You are equally comfortable thinking about the product concept and the last 10% of visual polish

•
You have already changed your workflow significantly because of AI

•
You prototype ideas yourself rather than waiting for engineers

•
You move unusually fast without sacrificing taste

•
You understand that the best prototype isn't necessarily a Figma prototype—it might be something a user can actually interact with

•
You care about outcomes, not design deliverables

•
You have strong opinions but change your mind quickly when the data or user feedback says otherwise

•
You're excited about designing products where AI itself is a core part of the user experience

What We Don't Want

This role is probably not a fit if:

•
Your primary strength is creating beautiful static screens

•
You rely on engineers for every functional prototype

•
You haven't meaningfully incorporated AI tools into your workflow

•
You prefer receiving detailed product requirements instead of helping define the product

•
You optimize primarily for design-process artifacts rather than shipped user outcomes

Being great at Figma is table stakes. It is not enough.

Ideal Background

There is no single required background, but strong candidates will often have some combination of:

•
4+ years of product design experience

•
Significant consumer mobile app experience

•
Experience shipping products used by hundreds of thousands or millions of users

•
Strong visual/UI design skills

•
Experience designing AI-powered product experiences

•
Experience building working prototypes with AI coding tools

•
Product management or founder experience

•
Motion/interaction design experience

•
Experience working in a high-growth startup or product-led company

Portfolio

When applying, please send:

•
2–3 consumer mobile products you've designed and explain specifically what you owned

•
A functional prototype you've built yourself , ideally using AI coding/prototyping tools

•
An example of how AI has changed your product design workflow

•
Your portfolio

•
Your favorite consumer mobile product right now and one thing you would improve about it

We care much more about what you've actually built and how you think than your title, degree, or years of experience.

Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial ecosystem, helping 10 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, and business management tools since 2019. As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, it powers most of the country’s Point of Sale (POS) transactions. Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

About the role:

As a Product Design Lead, you will own the execution of our design vision, managing a small team of designers across multiple teams to prioritise initiatives, drive strategic projects, and foster a culture of excellence. Balancing leadership with hands-on design, you will ensure we deliver business-driven, user-centred solutions that elevate the user experience.
This role requires strong leadership, UX/UI expertise, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to remove blockers, streamline workflows, and create scalable, accessible designs that align with both user and business needs.

What you’ll do

• Lead and manage a small team of product designers, ensuring project prioritisation, team alignment, and timely execution of high-quality design work.

• Mentor and inspire your team, fostering a culture of feedback, learning, and innovation through regular critiques, coaching, and skill development.

• Manage project timelines, roadmaps, and design workflows, ensuring the team delivers high-quality work on schedule.

• Maintain a hands-on approach, contributing directly to key design projects while balancing leadership responsibilities.

• Partner with product managers, engineers, and executives to translate strategic goals into user-friendly design solutions.

• Advocate for user-centred design by leveraging qualitative and quantitative research, usability testing, and behavioural insights to make informed design decisions.

• Ensure design consistency and scalability through the use of design systems and atomic design principles.

• Champion accessibility (a11y) and inclusive design, ensuring our products are usable by a diverse audience.

• Collaborate with analytics and product teams to measure the impact of design and optimise experiences based on data.

What you need to succeed

• A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to lead design teams and deliver end-to-end product design solutions across platforms, backed by user research and measurable impact.

• Experience leading and developing design teams, fostering collaboration, mentorship, and performance-driven growth.

• Expertise in UX/UI principles, interaction design, and user research methodologies, with a proven track record of delivering results-driven digital products.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and advocate for design at all levels.

• Strategic mindset, with the ability to translate product goals into scalable, flexible, and user-centric design solutions.

• Experience managing design workflows, tools, and operational processes to improve team efficiency and output.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively balancing multiple priorities while maintaining design excellence.

• Experience in fintech or SaaS, with a strong understanding of financial products, compliance, security, and designing for trust.

What you’ll get

• A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will influence design strategy and impact millions of users.

• Opportunities for career growth - mentorship, leadership development, and the ability to scale and shape a high-performing design team.

• Autonomy and influence - own design decisions, drive cross-functional collaboration, and define best practices.

• A high-performing and collaborative team - work alongside talented designers, engineers, and product managers in a culture that values design excellence.

• A culture of experimentation - we encourage bold ideas, rapid iteration, and data-driven design improvements.

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Remote-friendly work culture with support for professional development and engagement with the design community.

What to expect in the hiring process

• Application & portfolio review: we assess your experience, leadership impact, and UX case studies that demonstrate strategic thinking, process, and measurable outcomes.

• Preliminary phone call with recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, leadership experience, and expectations.

• Interview with senior leadership: a deep dive into your leadership approach, design philosophy, and ability to drive impact. This includes a discussion on past projects and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Design leadership challenge: a scenario-based assessment to assess both strategic thinking and leadership skills while balancing UX/UI expertise.

• Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership to assess alignment with our vision, strategic thinking, and team-building philosophy.

How to apply:

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your leadership in managing design teams, driving strategy, and delivering user-centred solutions with measurable business impact. We want to see case studies that demonstrate how you have led and developed designers, prioritised and managed projects, and fostered a high-performing team culture. Your portfolio should highlight how you have used research, data, and experimentation to inform decisions, optimise workflows, and drive success metrics.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer | Kimchi based in Spain.

This is an opportunity to join a small, senior design team shaping a fast-moving B2B platform built for engineers and technical teams working with AI-assisted software development. You will own complex product problems across coding agents, developer tooling, desktop experiences, and infrastructure and spend management interfaces. The role combines end-to-end product design, independent user research, product strategy, and hands-on prototyping. You will work closely with engineers and other designers, bringing a strong point of view while navigating ambiguity and technical constraints. AI-assisted development is an important part of the workflow, with opportunities to prototype directly in code rather than relying solely on traditional design tools. In a remote-first international environment, your work will directly influence how technical teams build, manage, and scale AI-powered development workflows.

Accountabilities:

• Own product problems end-to-end across CLI, desktop applications, inference and spend consoles, and developer tooling, from initial research through shipped designs and measurable outcomes.

• Lead user research independently by planning studies, conducting research, synthesizing findings, and translating insights into recommendations for product direction.

• Prototype directly in code when appropriate, using AI-assisted development workflows to test and validate ideas within the product.

• Contribute a clear point of view to product strategy discussions, supported by product usage, research evidence, competitive awareness, and an understanding of user needs.

• Collaborate with engineers and other designers to develop solutions that balance user experience, technical constraints, architecture, and business objectives.

• Participate in cross-team design reviews to identify overlap, maintain consistency, raise the quality bar, and stay aligned with broader product initiatives.

• Monitor design debt within your area and advocate for improvements when usability risks, technical constraints, or user feedback make them a priority.

• Communicate design decisions and research findings clearly through concise documentation and effective collaboration across a distributed organization.

Requirements:

• Senior-level product design experience demonstrated through a strong portfolio or case studies focused on developer tools, AI/LLM products, coding agents, or other technical and data-heavy SaaS platforms.

• Proven ability to own user research end-to-end and use research findings to influence product direction rather than simply contributing to studies led by others.

• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, combined with genuine interest in working directly with code and the product.

• Strong ability to form, communicate, and defend design decisions in ambiguous environments without relying on predefined processes.

• Experience designing for technical or engineering-focused users, with the confidence to discuss APIs, architecture, system constraints, and technical trade-offs with engineers.

• Strong asynchronous communication skills, including the ability to create concise documentation and make compelling cases through writing.

• Experience working independently across the full product design lifecycle, from research and discovery through prototyping, delivery, and measuring outcomes.

• Nice to have: experience designing CLI or terminal-based interfaces, familiarity with desktop applications, or experience presenting design and research findings to executive stakeholders.

• Strong curiosity, ownership, and willingness to work hands-on in a fast-moving product environment.

• Flexible, remote-first working environment.

• Equity options.

• Learning and development budget covering professional and personal development, including international conferences and courses.

• Annual hackathon focused on innovation and team collaboration.

• Team-building budget and company events.

• Equipment budget to support an effective remote workspace.

• Extra days off to support work-life balance.

• Opportunity to work with a global team of cloud and technology specialists on AI-powered developer products.

• Develop UX patterns and design foundations that improve consistency, usability, and delivery efficiency across projects.

• Facilitate workshops and alignment sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, turning different perspectives and competing inputs into clear decisions.

Requirements

• Hands-on experience working with content management systems; strong WordPress experience is highly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to translate business and user needs into clear flows, information architecture, interaction models, and polished UX solutions.

• Experience working effectively in fast-paced environments where priorities can be ambiguous or evolve quickly.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to bring structure, clarity, and momentum without unnecessarily complicating the process.

• Proven track record of shipping high-quality UX work that improves usability, engagement, conversion, or other meaningful product outcomes.
